headline: US stocks set to open higher as easing oil and yields support futures ahead of Delta earnings and sentiment data
raw_text:
- HUM (HUM) rises sharply pre-market on company-specific developments alongside strength in select small-cap names.
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) rise 0.37%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) gain 0.15%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) climb 0.81%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) edge 0.33% higher ahead of the cash open.
- Delta Air Lines (DAL) reports earnings before the bell with consensus EPS near $1.77 on roughly $17.7B in revenue.
- Oil (@CL) prices pull back around 1% while Treasury yields ease, supporting the rebound tone in equities.
- European equity markets traded firmer overnight while Asian markets closed mixed.
- University of Michigan consumer sentiment is due at 10:00 AM ET today.
- Baker Hughes (BKR) rig count is scheduled for 1:00 PM ET with no major data releases before the open.
